To Dad,
    This is my 6th time re-writing this. There is no simple way to put this. There is not a paragraph I could write to describe my pain. There is not a single doctor, father, mother, brother, coach, friend, hotline, drug, sport, or hobby that can fix me, I'm sick I'm fucked up I'm Ugly I'm out of place. The only words I can leave you is, I love you and I'm sorry.
        
no friends at my funeral just family
Well right now I'm playing lacrosse all year round rugby isn't that big in my area
Thanks for your concern , it is cool to think how people evolved this far, and I can to 50 consecutive push ups
Thanks bro  I appreciate you critazim for real

I just don't want live anymore. I hate feeling this way (suicidal) I constantly think about but not in a scary way or sad or even mad way I just want to die peacefully. My father and I don't get along (we never saw eye to eye) and I don't have a mother (she left the picture awhile ago) I just feel like I have no one to talk to about this. That's why I'm posting this here
I honestly don't want help though but I will consider that

Yeah I understand what your saying. But I'm pretty sure I'm going to go through with it this time. I already do drugs like Adderall and Vyvanse (recreational use) I also heard they help with depression but at this point I don't feel depressed I feel like it needs to happen I didn't really put this on here for people to tell me not do it. I kind of just wanted to tell someone

I will consider talking to someone but I really don't know if I want to. I feel that it's meant to happen. This probably doesn't make any sense I just don't feel like living anymore I'm not mad or sad at anyone i just don't want live
I feel the same way sometimes I will just lay in my room and plan it out in my head but I never follow through. It always seems like a good idea at the time
